name: Known issues
description: Failures of tests marked with @KnownIssue - already reported bugs.

name: Contract violations
description: Responses that do not match their JSON Schema or OpenAPI specification.

name: Product defects
description: The product behaved differently from what the test expects.

name: Test data problems
description: The test could not find or create the data it needs.

name: Environment / infrastructure
description: Unavailable services, timeouts, refused connections, device or driver problems.

name: Framework problems
description: Bugs or misconfiguration in the framework or the test code.
